turns.speaker: Maya
turns.text: Thanks for jumping on, Sam. Two things today: the launch date, and pricing for the Pro plan.

turns.speaker: Sam
turns.text: Morning, Maya. Engineering says we're on track, so the twenty-first still works.

turns.speaker: Maya
turns.text: Great, then let's lock in October twenty-first.

turns.speaker: Sam
turns.text: Agreed. I'll tell the support team today.

turns.speaker: Maya
turns.text: Now, pricing. I was going to say we keep it at twelve dollars a month, but [long-pause] the survey says people really want an annual plan.

turns.speaker: Sam
turns.text: So what if it's twelve a month, or a hundred dollars a year? That's about two months free.

turns.speaker: Maya
turns.text: I like that. Let's go with twelve a month and a hundred a year.

turns.speaker: Sam
turns.text: Okay. I'll update the pricing page and the checkout by Friday.

turns.speaker: Maya
turns.text: Can you make it Thursday? I want a day for QA before the newsletter goes out.

turns.speaker: Maya
turns.text: And I'll write the announcement and send it to legal by Wednesday.

turns.speaker: Sam
turns.text: One more thing. Do we give existing customers a discount?

turns.speaker: Maya
turns.text: Let's not decide that today. I'll ask finance, and we'll pick it up next week.
